newsitem.title: USA: Torotel in pact with Brockson Investment.
newsitem.headline: Torotel in pact with Brockson Investment.

text.p: Torotel Inc said Monday it signed a letter of intent for the possible sale of 1,990,050 shares of common stock for $2 million to Brockson Investment Co, based in Phoenix, Ariz.
Brockson will also purchase at the same price, or acquire voting rights of, stock from the company's founding family.
As a result of these transactions, Torotel said Brockson would acquire more than 50 percent of the company's outstanding shares.
These transactions require completion of due diligence, negotiation of definitive agreements and approval by Torotel shareholders, the company said in a statement.

Torotel said its directors reserved the right to provide information and to hold talks in response to an unsolicited proposal from other prospective purchasers as well as to terminate this letter of intent. If the letter of intent is terminated, a termination payment of $200,000 will be made to Brockson.
Torotel designs and makes switching power supplies and precision magnetic components used in commercial and military electronics.
Brockson Investment and Torotel officers were not available to provide more information.
